name: Cloudflare WAF MCP Server
description: Enables management of Cloudflare Ruleset Engine and WAF configurations through zone/account operations, ruleset management (add/update/delete rules), and access to Cloudflare documentation. Supports multi-zone and multi-account environments with built-in safety considerations.
